entities.summary: McKenzie Zachary Moore is an American professional basketball player for the Zavkhan Brothers of The League. He played college basketball for City College of San Francisco and the UTEP Miners before playing professionally in New Zealand, Belgium, Greece, Russia, Turkey, Poland, Israel, and the Philippines. He earned NZNBL MVP in 2016 playing for the Canterbury Rams.
